dish.title: Portuguese Grilled Sardines with Boiled Potatoes and Charred Pepper Salad
dish.description: Whole cleaned sardines brushed with olive oil and coarse salt and grilled over high heat until the skin blisters, served Lisbon-style with olive-oil boiled potatoes and a salad of charred red peppers, onion, garlic, and vinegar.

recipe_version.title: Portuguese Grilled Sardines with Boiled Potatoes and Charred Pepper Salad
recipe_version.description: Whole cleaned sardines brushed with olive oil and coarse salt and grilled over high heat until the skin blisters, served Lisbon-style with olive-oil boiled potatoes and a salad of charred red peppers, onion, garlic, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: whole fresh sardines
ingredients.display_name: whole fresh sardines, cleaned and scaled

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp sardines, 3 tbsp salad, 3 tbsp potatoes

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the sardines, pat them dry, and rub with 2 tbsp olive oil and 1 1/2 tsp coarse salt. Scrub the potatoes. Slice the onion and garlic, chop the parsley, and cut the lemons into wedges.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Put the potatoes in a 4-quart pot with 8 cups water and 1 tbsp kosher salt. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until tender, about 18 minutes; drain and toss with 3 tbsp olive oil and half the parsley. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Preheat the grill and char the peppers
steps.body: Preheat the grill on high, lid closed, for 10 minutes, then clean and oil the grate. Grill the whole peppers, turning, until blackened all over, about 10 minutes. Seal them in a bowl under a plate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Grill the sardines
steps.body: Grill the sardines (in a fish basket if you have one) until the skin chars and blisters and the flesh is opaque at the backbone, about 3 minutes per side.

steps.title: Dress the pepper salad
steps.body: Peel and seed the peppers and tear into strips. Toss with the onion, garlic, vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp coarse salt. The peppers can be peeled while the sardines cook (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Pile the sardines on a platter with the potatoes and pepper salad. Finish with the rest of the parsley and the lemon wedges.
